entities.summary: Gaius Claudius Pulcher, consul in 177 BC, was the son of Appius Claudius Pulcher, consul in 212 BC, and he was the father of Appius Claudius Pulcher, consul in 143 BC. His brothers were Appius Claudius Pulcher and Publius Claudius Pulcher.
